newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy three-yr plan ready by end of week - Veltroni.
newsitem.headline: Italy three-yr plan ready by end of week - Veltroni.

text.p: Italy's three-year rolling economic plan, which will outline the government's taxing and spending plans for 1998, will be ready by the end of the week, Prime Minister Walter Veltroni said.
"This is the week at the end of which there will be a DPEF," said Veltroni, referring to the acronym by which the three-year strategy document is known.
Veltroni said he hoped the broadest possible consensus could be reached among parties supporting Prime Minister Romano Prodi's centre-left government on the plan.

Communist Refoundation leader Fausto Bertinotti said earlier on Tuesday that a meeting of party leaders supporting the Prodi government had not resolved differences over the DPEF, particularly over the future of the welfare state.
Bertinotti, on whose party the government relies for its majority in the lower house of parliament, said the plan did not get to grips with rising unemployment, Italy's poor south and tax evasion.
The government is to meet trade union and industrial employers on Thursday at 1500 GMT to discuss the three-year strategy ahead of a cabinet meeting on Friday.
